fields.title: Chatbot System in Medical Field.
fields.content:
Internet communication is getting more and more popular among the people. Due to the advancement in technology such as Artificial Intelligent (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and data mining techniques, critical decision making capabilities such as chatbots have become more practical with many commercial fields. Medical field has also been affected with this kind of technology. Medical field has adopted a chatbot system to facilitate the patient and doctor’s interaction. Chatbot system has been introduced as an interface between doctors or any health related professional with users. Chatbot has become a personal health assistant that uses a patient-doctor communication model. Many people use Google search to get information about disease and treatment of their disease. But the internet is also full of fake news and information which misleads the viewers to sell something. Chatbot will help users to interact with health organisations via platforms of their choice such as web applications or mobile applications. Large amount of data is generated from the medical field with the help of chatbot so that information can be accessed safely which will be delivered to the end users.

Why we need this type of innovation

As we all know that many people are facing tremendous problems for personal health care in this rapidly growing world. In this busy world, People find it time consuming to visit hospitals or consult with doctors when they have minor symptoms or disease. But they would like to get easy access to health related queries without visiting hospitals, without consulting with doctor’s or any medical staff. Similarly many patients who are suffering from mild disease such as cough, headache, fever etc. visit hospitals to consult with doctors which makes it difficult for doctors to take care of critical patients. Critical people are not getting doctor’s appointments due to the unnecessary crowd of people who are visiting hospitals due to the minor symptoms or who don't need to get the doctor's full attention. So these are the problems that the health sector are facing due to the unknown knowledge of technology which could be minimised with this application.

How chatbot can come as a solution

Many people want doctor’s advice for their healthy life. What if we develop a software which will give a relative answer to the patient who wants a doctor's cure within their hands? Using web applications they can take care of their health without visiting hospitals and spending money for doctor’s consultation. This application will help patients to get queries regarding disease as well as queries about doctor or hospital speciality. This technology will also reduce the time of doctor’s as well as patients by providing fast interaction with the system.

Types of Chatbot

1. Rule Based Chatbot

Rule based chatbot system is a type of chatbot system where certain data are trained. When a user asks a question without giving a condition, the chatbot will not be able to answer the questions. Rule based chatbot system uses if/else condition to answer queries. So this type of chatbot system is more flexible in terms of question answering chat then that of ML type chatbot system. In such a type of chatbot system admin can manipulate data according to their needs.

2. AI Based Chatbot

This is the advanced type of chatbot system, where chatbot is trained with datasets and Natural Language Processing. When a user asks a question the bot will understand the query using NLP and analyse using an algorithm and find patterns of user question and answer accordingly. In this type of chatbot, chatbot uses a pattern matching algorithm to process all the information provided by the user and provide the best and fast response to the user. A unique pattern is available for each kind of question in the database to provide a suitable response. This algorithm reduces the classifier and generates a more manageable structure.

3. Hybrid Chatbot system

Hybrid chatbot system is the combination of both rule based and AI based chatbot systems. Building the chatbot system only using AI is more complex so the hybrid chatbot can be the option to develop more advanced using both rule and AI based chatbot systems.


﻿Conclusion

The rise and popularity of chatbot is increasing day by day. The time spent with chatbot compared to health related people is very low. The low interaction time reflects the high understanding and speech recognition rates, offered through the adaptation of conversational user interfaces thus allowing users to freely interact with the chatbot to meet the demands of modern life. The Chatbot has proven itself as a most demanding application of users wanting instant access and availability information and services. I believe this project can be very beneficial in the sector of health on the successful development of the project. Various machine learning and artificial intelligent technology will be used in the project. Artificial Neural Network (ANN), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Natural Language Understanding (NLU), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Long Short Term Memory Network (LSTMs) etc are the crucial parts for developing the modern chatbot system.

Future Scope of chatbot system 

Due to the obstacles like time constraints other features could not be added that will be added in future some of them are: we can add and publish news articles about health as a feature. Fetching new health research papers, news about World Health can be added for user experience. There is also the possibility of adding reminders for patients who used to take medicine daily in a time interval. After finishing the project in a web app we can also develop it as a mobile application having different features such as dieting plan, direct contact with specific specialist doctors.

fields.title: Entrepreneurship
fields.content:
Have you ever wondered how these giant companies like Apple, Tesla, Uber formed? It’s not about what they do, it's about how they do things differently. Entrepreneurship is an activity strike to differentiate things involved creatively and adding new innovation by an individual or small group of partners, it tools safely but the world world entrepreneurship depicts the mindset of seeking opportunities in every problem and come out with innovative and creative solutions.

Entrepreneur is an individual who creates new business bearing most of the risks and enjoying most of the new areas. While entrepreneurship can be categorized under various categories. The most native definition for it would be the act of creating a business or businesses while building and scaring it to generate a recurring profit. While most entrepreneurs focus on the building business by definition, a lot of the responsibilities revolve around creating a better society, initiating new strategies, solving big problems, etc. It may just sound easy, but it involves various stages and events that follow one another. Entrepreneurs play on important role in shaping the economy, they 

Generate new capabilities in the economy, they provide jobs promoting the economy and provide jobs promoting innovation. Society has therefore benefited from the growth and development of these entrepreneurial ventures. It is said that with great power comes great responsibilities and it is vital that these industries create better opportunities serving the society along with expanding their business. Although the term ‘Entrepreneur’ might sound very simple and straight forward, it demands various character traits from an individual. Most skills for entrepreneurs included hardworking, passionate, confident to execute strategies, and most importantly problem-solving abilities. 

Entrepreneurship Starts With:

  • Idea generation and defining your business

The most initial step into entrepreneurship is to generate ideas. An entrepreneur begins to wonder why there is a lack of availability of product or services and how to improve certain things as well as how to generate income to cover all the expenses, etc. It requires an in-depth analysis of the market and the probability of sustaining in the market before making the first move. It is important that the business has a well defined space to work in. Establishing a good working environment for business is as important as coming up with ideas. Regardless of how saturated the industry is, they have their own unique selling point (USP) which makes it easy for customers and clients to see why they need to do business with you. When forming your USP, it helps to define not only what you are selling, but why you are the obciouschoice for your customers and clients. Having a well-defined foundation is the key to a successful business. It is mainly at this stage where many tend to give up and go back into their past lives and perhaps even abandon the idea of starting a business. Thus, the first stage of entrepreneurship is very important.

  • Decision Making

A critical point in the entrepreneurial process is deciding to start the project. It is vital that the individual stays active and motivated. These are the main factors for the entrepreneur to start landing on creative ideas. It is important that the individual takes the resources and the material required along with its cost and availability to generate at least one way to move forward into entrepreneurship. The development of the business plan will mark only a guide that can be used as a reference, it is in the hands of the entrepreneurs that makes the path for the business to grow and take shape as it develops. It is indeed tough to make decisions as an organization.

  • Business Planning

Planning the pathway for a business is an essential step to creating a smoother process to run the business plans for longer duration. A few things all solid business plans should have, including business model, strategy, creating a niche, understanding the target audience and budget the financial information.

  • Project creation and Marketing strategies

The step of entrepreneurship where an individual creates opportunities and develops ideas with creativity. This step involves the development and execution of the strategies of the company. Many times, it is the step where the entrepreneurs face most difficulties as mistakes are made which makes difficulties in the real time. Communication and information delivery skills are required in this step. While this is done, it is also important to market the product services in such a way that it sells itself without having to put effort into convincing. A major aspect of this is to market the product in a way that it attracts the consumers itself without having the company officials to approach potential consumers. What makes the business values and ethics? Now all that remains is to make some noise about it. Coming up with a well structured strategy, and an efficient marketing plan will not only ensure that the efforts are most effective but also that no time is wasted on things that won't necessarily work.

  • Management and Control

Once the above mentioned stages are cleared, the first few months of the company will determine whether it will last a long time or not. It is essential that the company follows a strategic management and control operation throughout the duration of the working hours to maintain a structure and discipline the organization. Even though it might seem that things are starting to work out, it is most important to invest in the future of the company with an efficient money control system. A manager for the company to ensure that the business is well managed and maintained would be a better investment for the company rather than having a bigger sized office area. Budgeting and creating revenue must be the main goal.

Perhaps one could say that the entrepreneurial process ends here, but the successful are those who do not stop learning and experimenting.

fields.title: Cultural Capital Bhaktapur
fields.content:
Bhaktapur is a mystic city. Bhaktapur, which means "place of worshippers," is located 13 kilometres east of Kathmandu in the Kathmandu valley. Bhaktapur was founded in the 12th century by King Ananda Malla and served as the original capital of the Malla Kingdom before becoming an independent kingdom in the 15th century. Despite its age, it may not be an exaggeration to say that it is the only city that has retained its historic shape even in the 21st century.



With towering pagoda-style temples forming the iconic Nepali stairway to heaven, Bhaktapur is an architectural marvel, with many buildings remaining as they were in mediaeval times. Bhaktapur is also known for its pottery, and you can still see pots drying in the sun and being thrown and fired at Pottery Square today. This place is best known for its finest traditional crafts and rich cultural heritages so it is also the destination for art lovers. The Durbar Square is a gem of Bhaktapur city and one of Kathmandu Valley's seven UNESCO World Heritage Sites. The Durbar Square, located in the city's core, is home to pagodas, shikhara-style temples, Buddhist monasteries, and more. In the Durbar square, we can observe a beautiful art and craft image of King Bhupatindra Malla holding hands in front of the Taleju temple. Stone sculptures, wood carvings, the National Art Gallery, the 55 Windows Palace, Nyatapola temple, Krishna temple, Pashupati temple, and Dattatarya temple are just a few of the fine architectural structures that tourists spend time looking for and examining.While Kathmandu and Patan are stunning, Bhaktapur is a cut above due to the workmanship of its temples and shrines, which have been compared to the Hindu model culture. Bhaktapur is a city of devotees with a plethora of landmark wonders.



Bhaktapur is a paradise for art lovers. The whole city can be a live museum. Visitors to Kathmandu almost often include a trip to Bhaktapur in their itinerary. It's worth it only to try the famous "Juju Dhau," which translates to "King Curd”.So, in order for the tourism industry to flourish, Bhaktapur should be developed and promoted for the benefit of both tourists and the district's economy.
